senses.gloss:
mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Having ugly nails.
n. (-खं)
A disease of the nails.
E.
कु bad, and नख a nail; also with इनि added, कुनखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि).

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
Having bad or diseased nails.
E.
कुनख, and इनि aff.

m. (-टः)
A sort of trumpet flower.
f. (-टी)
1 Red arsenic.
2 Coriander.
E.
कु the earth, and नट to dance, to be; also कुलटी.

m. (-ली)
A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.)
E.
कु bad, नल a stalk, and इनि aff.

m. (-भिः)
1 A whirlwind.
2 KUVERA'S aggregate treasure: see निधि.
E.
कु the world, and नाभि the navel.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Javāsa: see यवास.
E.
कु the earth, and नाशक what injures.

f. (-तिः)
1 Impolicy, misgovernment.
2 Ill conduct, misbehaviour.
E.
कु bad, नीति policy.

mf. (-न्तः-न्ती)
1 A bearded dart, a lance.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A species of grain, (Coix barbata, Rox.)
2 A small animal, an insect.
3 Passionateness.
f. (-न्तिः or -न्ती)
1 The wife of PĀṆḌU, and mother of the three elder PĀṆḌAVA princes by as many gods.
2 The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
3 Bdellium, a fragrant resin.
4 The wife of a Brahman.
E.
कु bad, and अन्त end, destroying ill, enemies, &c. or क the head, and उन्द to give pain, त substituted for द, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्.

m. (-लः)
1 Hair.
2 A drinking cup.
3 Barley.
4 A plough.
5 The name of a country in the north-west of the peninsula.
m. plu. (-लाः)
The people of that country, the inhabitants of Kuntala.
E.
कुन्त a dart, and ला to bring or gain, क aff.

f. (-का)
A butter-knife or scoop.
E.
कुन्तल a cup, &c. and इकन् aff.

r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति)
1 To cling to, to twine round or be connected with.
2 To be distressed.
3 To suffer pain, want, &c.: see कुथ.

m. (-न्थुः)
1 The seventeenth of the Jinas or deified Jaina saints.
2 One of the Jaina emperors of the world.

mn. (-न्दः-न्दं)
A kind of jasmin, (J. multiflorum or pubescens.)
m. (-न्दः)
1 A turner's lathe.
2 Olibanum, the resin of the Boswellia thurifera: see कुन्दरु.
3 One of KUVERA'S nine treasures.
4 The Nerium plant.
E.
कु to sound, दन Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted, or कु the earth, उन्द to hurt, and अण् affix; also with कन् added कुन्दक.

m. (-मः)
A cat.
E.
कु vile, (animals, as mice,) and दम who tames.

m. (-रः)
A sort of grass.

f. (-नी)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
कुन्द the jasmin, and इनि affix, fem. affix ङीप्; an assemblage like that of Kunda flowers, from the similar whiteness of the lotus.

f. (-न्दुः)
Frankincense or olibanum: see कुन्दुरु.
m. (-न्दुः)
A rat, a mouse.
E.
कु the earth, and दृ to tear or divide, डु aff.

m. (-रः)
Olibanum: see कुन्दुरु.

mf. (-रुः)
The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, gum olibanum or frankincense.
E.
क BRAHMĀ, उन्द to moisten, (to bedew with incense in sacrifice,) रु affix, उक् inserted.
m. (-रुः)
A rat: see कुन्दु.

mf. (-कः-की)
The olibanum tree, commonly Salaī or Salae, (Boswellia thurifera.)
m. (-कः)
The gum.
E.
कन् possessive or pleonastic added to कुन्दुरु, fem. affix ङीष्.

r. 10th cl. (कूनयति)
To contract or close.
